name: Yuri-iro no Shoujo
source:
Main character gets a teacher job at a girls academy. Among the students he discovers his favorite student he was tutoring. A lot of her friends and teachers desire to deprive her of purity. Will protagonist be able to protect his student from these temptations?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一所女子学院获得了教师职位。在学生中，他发现了他曾经辅导过的心爱学生。她的很多朋友和老师都渴望夺走她的纯洁。主人公能否保护他的学生免受这些诱惑？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
